summary: This Mol Labs public report (P19) is a research discussion card proposing an assay to test whether ARA-290 (cibinetide), a non-hematopoietic IRR/CD131 tissue-protective EPO-derived peptide, retains ≥50% of its IRR/CD131 tissue-protection under a hematopoietic-matched EPO condition that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection attribution via hematopoiesis. The document frames this as an "irr-insufficiency assumption-kill" hypothesis, cataloguing four supporting literature priors (Wang, Winicki, Dennhardt, Ghassemi-Barghi) while noting that none of them constitute the required residual-under-hematopoietic-match head-to-head experiment. The key experimental result (matched residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 phenotype under hematopoietic match) is explicitly UNKNOWN and not yet run.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis (P19)
content_blocks.content: On a matched insult ± ARA-290 (cibinetide) ± EPO (or EPO-R agonist) panel with hematocrit/reticulocyte-match QC that abolishes EPO-alone tissue-protection attribution via hematopoiesis, plus IRR/CD131 tissue-protection endpoint (optional βCR/CD131 block): under that hematopoietic match, residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 tissue-protection remains ≥50% of the ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm on the same panel. Named comparator = ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm under matched insult. This is an assumption-kill / irr-insufficiency test.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: Wang frames ARA290 neuroprotection via β-common/IRR without erythropoiesis; Winicki shows non-hematopoietic ARA290 cardiac/healthspan benefit; Dennhardt separates EPO vs pHBSP IRR from EPO-R erythropoiesis in HUS; Ghassemi-Barghi maps ARA290 as EPO/CD131 heteroreceptor ligand in nephrotoxicity. P19 asks whether residual IRR/CD131 tissue-protection under a hematopoietic match that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection attribution via hematopoiesis still requires the IRR path rather than hematopoietic attribution — irr-insufficiency assumption-kill.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: irr-insufficiency assumption-kill: Wang shows ARA290 βCR/IRR neuroprotection without erythropoiesis (LITERATURE); Winicki shows non-hematopoietic ARA290 cardiac/healthspan (LITERATURE); Dennhardt shows EPO vs pHBSP IRR distinct from EPO-R erythropoiesis (LITERATURE); Ghassemi-Barghi maps ARA290 EPO/CD131 IRR nephrotoxicity mechanistics (LITERATURE). None score residual ARA-290 under a hematocrit/reticulocyte-matched EPO condition that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection attribution on the same panel. Non-hematopoietic / without-erythropoiesis / did-not-alter-hematocrit framing is the class PRIOR under kill — PRIOR lack-of-hematopoiesis ≠ matched residual H2H.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
1. Wang (PMID 38488446 / DOI 10.1111/cns.14676 / PMC10941562): ARA290 neuroprotection via β-common receptor (βCR/IRR) in MCAO mice; βCR siRNA suppresses effect; without causing erythropoiesis — IRR/β-common tissue-protection prior; NOT residual-under-hematopoietic-match H2H.
2. Winicki (PMID 36741836 / DOI 10.3389/fcvm.2022.1096887 / PMC9889362): ARA290 (cibinetide) non-hematopoietic EPO-derived peptide reduces cardiac inflammation, attenuates age-associated heart-function decline, prolongs healthspan — non-hematopoietic cardiac prior; NOT residual under hematocrit-matched EPO abolish.
3. Dennhardt (PMID 36211426 / DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2022.1010882 / PMC9537456): EPO or pHBSP targeting IRR axis attenuates HUS in mice; IRR pharmacologically distinct from EPO-R erythropoiesis — EPO vs pHBSP IRR prior; NOT hematocrit-matched residual H2H co-panel.
4. Ghassemi-Barghi (PMID 36085231 / DOI 10.1007/s10753-022-01737-7): ARA290 specific ligand for EPO/CD131 heteroreceptor; protective vs cisplatin nephrotoxicity — CD131/IRR mechanistics prior; NOT residual under hematocrit-matched EPO abolish.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Experimental Status
content_blocks.content: Wang βCR/IRR stroke LITERATURE (PMID 38488446; phenotype ≠ residual-under-hematopoietic-match H2H). Winicki non-hematopoietic cardiac LITERATURE (PMID 36741836; adjacent ≠ residual H2H). Dennhardt EPO vs pHBSP IRR HUS LITERATURE (PMID 36211426; scored without hematocrit/reticulocyte-matched EPO arm that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection). Ghassemi-Barghi CD131 nephrotoxicity LITERATURE (PMID 36085231; adjacent ≠ residual H2H). Matched residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 phenotype under hematopoietic match that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection on same panel: UNKNOWN (soft-complete Q1 NON-MATCH / matched residual Q1b=0). Residual ≥50% of ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm under hematopoietic-match-abolish condition: PREDICTION. Execution status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design (Method)
content_blocks.content: Method: propose-assay. Lock one insult ± ARA-290 ± EPO (or EPO-R agonist) system with hematocrit/reticulocyte-match QC that abolishes EPO-alone tissue-protection attribution, IRR/CD131 tissue-protection readout (optional βCR/CD131 block), and ≥50%-of-ARA-290-without-matched-EPO residual gate before claiming residual under hematopoietic match. Prefer named published tissue-protection panel with hematology match QC / explant+hematology before new animal/human. No dosing. NOT FOXO4×LOF.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered matched insult ± ARA-290 ± EPO (or EPO-R agonist) panel where hematopoietic match abolishes EPO-alone tissue-protection attribution via hematopoiesis, residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 tissue-protection is <50% of the ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm under that same condition — so hematopoietic-attribution framing survives and irr-insufficiency residual fails — when incomplete hematopoietic match, EPO-alone tissue-protection-not-abolished, absent residual, or hematocrit-match QC artifacts that would otherwise leave the test inconclusive are ruled out.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P1–P18 as proving P19 — Wang/Winicki/Dennhardt/Ghassemi-Barghi IRR/non-hematopoietic priors are not a residual-under-hematopoietic-matched-EPO H2H; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual phenotype.
2. Skip-list / series distinctness (critical) — do not freeze or collapse to OpenLabs 8e5ba06c / 7db12286 BPC orthosteric dialect, P15 residual-FBXO22, P16 LKKTETQ-Cc, P17 MOTS-c/folate, or P18 SS-31/ROS-scavenger; orthosteric_drift=false.
3. Wang/Winicki/Dennhardt/Ghassemi-Barghi lack hematocrit/reticulocyte-matched EPO arm that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection; incomplete hematopoietic match / EPO-alone tissue-protection not abolished / no residual to score / hematocrit-match QC failure leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted; no dosing; reviews 25728128 / 31580542 ≠ experimental anchors.

key_findings: ARA-290 (cibinetide) is a non-hematopoietic IRR/CD131 tissue-protective EPO-derived peptide; P19 proposes an irr-insufficiency assumption-kill assay to test whether its tissue-protection is truly IRR-dependent rather than hematopoietic.

Four literature priors support IRR/non-hematopoietic framing: Wang (PMID 38488446, βCR/IRR neuroprotection in MCAO without erythropoiesis), Winicki (PMID 36741836, non-hematopoietic cardiac/healthspan benefit), Dennhardt (PMID 36211426, EPO vs pHBSP IRR distinct from EPO-R erythropoiesis in HUS), Ghassemi-Barghi (PMID 36085231, ARA290 as EPO/CD131 heteroreceptor ligand in nephrotoxicity).

None of the four literature priors constitute the required residual-under-hematopoietic-match head-to-head experiment; matched residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 phenotype under hematopoietic match is explicitly UNKNOWN.

The key prediction: under EPO (or EPO-R agonist) hematopoietic match that abolishes EPO-class tissue-protection attribution via hematopoiesis, residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 tissue-protection ≥50% of the ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm on the same panel.
Execution status is NOT_RUN; FTO status is UNKNOWN; estimated time to refute is 6 weeks; kill cost tier = 2.
Refutation criterion: residual ARA-290 IRR/CD131 tissue-protection <50% of the ARA-290 without-matched-EPO arm (when confounds such as incomplete hematopoietic match are ruled out).

Model systems referenced in prior art: Mouse MCAO/reperfusion (Wang), aged Fischer 344 × Brown Norway rats (Winicki), murine HUS model (Dennhardt), HEK-293/ACHN cells with cisplatin nephrotoxicity (Ghassemi-Barghi).

Proposed assay requires: matched insult ± ARA-290 ± EPO panel, hematocrit/reticulocyte-match QC, IRR/CD131 tissue-protection endpoint, optional βCR/CD131 block, and ≥50% residual gate; prefer named published tissue-protection panel with hematology match QC before new animal/human studies.
